projects.title: Concept Car — autonomous driving function
projects.blurb: Two-wheeled vehicle that drives a closed course untethered. Plant model and control law developed in Simulink, sequencing as a Stateflow chart, deployed as generated embedded C on a SAMD21.
highlights: Motor characterised by measured sweep, dead band included, rather than datasheet values
Route as a state machine with relative targets, so one four-state cycle closes any polygon
Verification retrofitted as CI: static analysis plus a requirements traceability gate

projects.title: agent-skills
projects.blurb: 13 Claude Code skills I wrote: document and scan pipelines, machine-inventory generators, session cost telemetry, and a delegating orchestrator.
highlights: Scan pipeline that OCRs, classifies and renames documents with a never-delete staging gate
Cost and cache-hit dashboards built over local session telemetry
Multi-agent orchestrator with explicit human approval gates

projects.title: lineart-svg
projects.blurb: Photo to single-colour SVG pipeline with a checkpointed review loop, output constrained to be Bambu Studio importable.
highlights: Human approval gate between raster generation and vectorisation
Emboss-mesh aware output for 3D print workflows

projects.title: Document scan pipeline
projects.blurb: Batch pipeline that separates, deskews, OCRs, classifies and renames scanned engineering records, writing structured metadata back to the filesystem.
highlights: Recovered true document dates after a drive migration destroyed file mtimes
Never-delete policy with a staged review directory

projects.title: Tower-TrackStack
projects.blurb: Passive daily engineering log. Aggregates session, git and shell activity into a committed markdown record.
highlights: Zero-effort capture — runs on a schedule, commits itself

projects.title: cansig
